note: Capability claim DAG (C01, issue #45; plan section 7). Nodes are stamped ONLY by checks registered in src/gf180_dx7/capabilities.py CHECKS; evidence lives in evidence/capabilities/<node>.json and is produced exclusively by tools/compile_capabilities.py --stamp, which captures bounded output (sha256 + tail) and unittest run/skip counts into the record (issue #206). skip_policy governs a check-level guarded skip: "pass" keeps it within PASS when the gap is named in exclusions; "not_run" forces NOT_RUN. A required control that reported a skip always forces NOT_RUN. A check reports a skip only when its registry-declared skip_token appears in its captured output: whether a registered check can guard-skip at all, and the exact token it emits when it does, is declared per check in CHECKS (skip_token, issue #232), so an undeclared skip wording cannot hide from detection and an incidental token occurrence in a check that declares no skip path cannot fabricate a skip it never performed. Declared-but-unregistered nodes (engine 'planned: ...') can never pass. This file is data for the compiler; never hand-edit the generated views (docs/CAPABILITIES.md, docs/capabilities.json, README block).
